Record Class EnrollmentToken

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.who.enrollment.EnrollmentToken
Record Components:
id - stable UUID identifying this token record
identityId - the identity this token is associated with
value - the shareable token value delivered to the end user
status - current lifecycle status (PENDING, REDEEMED, or REVOKED)
createdAt - when the token was created
expiresAt - when the token expires
redeemedAt - when the token was redeemed, or null if not yet redeemed
public record EnrollmentToken(UUID id, UUID identityId, String value, EnrollmentTokenStatus status, Instant createdAt, Instant expiresAt, Instant redeemedAt) extends Record
An immutable enrollment token that links a Credential to a pre-existing Identity.

The token value is a secret random string, distinct from the id, and is what gets shared with the end user. toString() never prints it. Expiry is determined at runtime — EXPIRED is not stored as a status.
